name: Laurea University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in the Helsinki region (Espoo and Vantaa); six English bachelor's for 2027 in business, service, nursing, social work and online IT.

ib.text: An IB Diploma makes you eligible; places are then won through the International UAS Exam or Laurea's own entrance exam, depending on the programme.

dates.label: International UAS Exam, online from 12:00 Finnish time

programmes.name: Business Management
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam. Leppävaara campus, Espoo.

programmes.name: Cyber Security, Business Information Technology
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam. Online studies only in 2027.

programmes.name: Developing Digital Services, Business Information Technology
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam. Online studies only in 2027.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.ib: Laurea's own entrance exam; you also need Finnish at B1 and English at B2.

programmes.name: Social Services
programmes.ib: Laurea's own entrance exam. Blended learning at Tikkurila.

notes: Safety, Security and Risk Management is not open in the January 2027 round, and neither are the campus versions of Cyber Security and Developing Digital Services.
The two IT degrees run fully online in 2027, so you would study remotely rather than on a Finnish campus.
Nursing in English still requires basic Finnish (B1) when you apply.
